# `div`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Divide `expr1` by `expr2`. It returns NULL if an operand is NULL or `expr2` is 0. The result is casted to long.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
expr1 div expr2
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- div, example 1
> SELECT 3 div 2;
1
```

```sql
-- div, example 2
> SELECT INTERVAL '1-1' YEAR TO MONTH div INTERVAL '-1' MONTH;
-13
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
